source: 846 (op, waves) records OCR-extracted from the #gda-ops Discord channel (scripts/extractGdaOpsRuns.js) merged with the hand-recorded runs in data/opObservations.json.
notes: MEASURED wave counts from many DIFFERENT accounts at many different investment levels. The spread within an op is mostly roster strength, not run variance — run variance measured on identical lineups is under 3%.

waveRate.js anchors its depth-to-wave mapping to the median here: a lineup that exactly holds an op reference enemy team (100% depth in the sim) is mapped to that op median observed result. That is the calibration the model previously lacked entirely, which is why it reported ~0 waves for ops people routinely push past 1000.

User anchor (2026-07-26): a roster of five characters at level 660 or above clears the first 500-800 waves with relative speed and ease. The medians below bracket that range, which is the independent check on the anchoring choice.
Do not pool REWARD rates across these runs — reward per wave carries an account-level multiplier. Wave counts are comparable; reward amounts are not.
